deployment_targets.notes: In-memory mode. Set DATABASE_URL for Postgres.
After npm install. Use pm2 or systemd.

env_vars.name: DATABASE_URL
env_vars.description: Postgres connection string. Empty = in-memory test mode.

env_vars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Provider API key — server-side only, NEVER in client

env_vars.name: LOG_LEVEL
env_vars.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error

rollback_notes: Revert migration: DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;. Deploy previous build artifact. Restore database from backup.
known_non_claims: This is a testbed, NOT a production SaaS platform
In-memory store loses all data on restart
Rate limiting is simulated — not a real distributed rate limiter
Autocannon smoke is local only — does not represent production traffic
known_risks: No persistent storage in default mode
